contexts.text: Arabia and the sons of the east () = the possession of celestial riches, or of those which are of love. AC 414:2.
Under Ancient Church, see this reference.

Arabia and all the Princes of Kedar, these were thy traders (), where Tyre is treated of, by which is signified those who are in knowledges of good and truth; Arabia stands for their wisdom; the Princes of Kedar, for their intelligence.

Arabia and the kingdoms of Hazor (), in the opposite sense, stand for those who are in knowledges of celestial and spiritual things, with the end of no other use than that they may be reputed wise and intelligent by themselves and the world.
Arabia () = those who are in celestial things; that is, who are in the goods of faith.
That Kedar is Arabia, is evident from the following places; and that Arabia was named Kedar from a son of Ishmael, may be evident from...
Arabia () stands for spiritual good; the Princes of Kedar, for spiritual truths.
They who are not in truth, because not in good, are they who are represented by the Arabians and by the Kedarites in the desert. Illustrated.
To pass the night in the forest of Arabia () = being vastated as to truth.
Arabia and the sons of the east = those who are in knowledges of good and truth.
The manner of writing of the Arabians, Syrians and Greeks...
The flocks of Arabia = all the goods of the inward man... Arabia = where good is.
The science of correspondences among the Arabians...
(How it was that the science of correspondences came to be cultivated in Arabia.) DSS 102.
The ancient Word was in Arabia, etc.
The Arabic language referred to. AE 1010. See WE 3557.
The letters used by some Angels of the Celestial Kingdom are like the Arabic letters.
The flocks of Arabia = knowledges of truth and of good.
Arabia and the Princes of Kedar = those who are in truths and goods from knowledges.
Arabia = the natural man, for an Arab in the desert is the natural man.
Arabia = where they are who live naturally in goods; that is, according to their religiosity.
Arabia and Hazor = knowledges of good and truth.
Because the Orientals were in knowledges of good and truth, they were called the sons of the east; that they who were from Arabia were so called...
An Arab in the desert () = him who as a robber in the desert kills and deprives [others].
Arabia = the Church that is in truths from good.
An Arabian = one who lives in the desert.
(). Arabia = those who pervert knowledges of good.
That wisdom flourished in Arabia appears from the coming of the Queen of Sheba to Solomon, and from the three wise men.
